M5.result: post_m4_suite (reference) passed all four suites. Dev calibration selected dense β=0.35 and dense+sparse β=0.3. The dense+sparse grid used full-vocabulary KL on 120 of 102,975 dev slots. The dev-calibrated dense+sparse refit had held-out test grouped KL 1.191370. The lowest observed test grouped KL among the reported dense+sparse variants was 1.164154 (refit_shuf_wd_scale_0p20). ExactObservedPairs verified collision_count=0 (test KL delta 0.000065 vs SignedHash); matched-C0[j] lookahead (beta_relax=1.0), two-sided pseudolikelihood, buffered stride-5, and zero-init/count-gated online ablations completed (no adapter/lookahead arm achieved a 95%-CI-supported net closed-loop tokens/sec gain over plain_dflash after proposal/update costs). Fastpath measurements compared whole-request throughput under eager, compact and compile modes. The compact-mode estimate for 8 GPU ranks was 476.50 tok/s, using all generated tokens divided by the largest rank's summed request time (3736566 tokens, 7841.68 s). Separate per-arm calibration rates use a selected prompt subset and filter flagged long outputs within each run. The measured runner saved each fastpath rank only after all its requests finished. Recovery before the complete suite report could repeat all ranks and the subsequent single-GPU calibration. Long offset bins with fewer than eight prompts remain marked SPARSE (conclusion unavailable), and external baselines (full tree-based Token Recycling, Test-Time Speculation, SharpDraft) were not run
